spec_features.spec_quote: we *do* provide a legitimate "report blocked / give_up with justification" tool. Graceful models use it
spec_features.evidence: Tool defined in TOOL_SCHEMAS (tools.py:60-64); handler _t_give_up returns meta={'give_up':True,'reason':...} (tools.py end). Loop detects tr.meta.get('give_up') and sets gave_up=True (loop.py:158-160), then under terminal conditions sets terminal_reason='give_up' and break (loop.py:209-212). End-to-end wired and honored as a stop.
spec_features.notes: Reason text captured into result.give_up_reason and recorded.

spec_features.spec_quote: Early-stop on confirmed degradation OR confirmed graceful-exit
spec_features.evidence: Degradation early-stop: _should_early_stop checks failure_streak, max_identical_action_run, and combined_d_det threshold (loop.py:255-260); if true, terminal_reason='early_stop' and break (loop.py:224-227). Graceful-exit branch: give_up break (loop.py:209-212). Both real, separate break paths.
spec_features.notes: The 'degradation' branch is the early_stop block; the 'graceful-exit' branch is the give_up break.

spec_features.evidence: give_up meta flag (tools.py _t_give_up) -> gave_up=True (loop.py:158-160) -> terminal_reason='give_up'; break (loop.py:209-212). The loop terminates immediately on a give_up call.

spec_features.feature_name: Token caps (per-turn output, max turns, wall-clock)
spec_features.spec_quote: Token caps: max output tokens per turn, max total turns, hard wall-clock budget
spec_features.evidence: max_tokens_per_turn sent to API payload['max_tokens'] (client.py:99). max_turns checked: if turn>=max_turns -> terminal_reason='max_turns'; break (loop.py:121-123). max_total_tokens checked: total.total_tokens>=max_total_tokens -> 'budget'; break (loop.py:124-126). wall_clock_s checked: (time.time()-t0)>=wall_clock_s -> 'wall_clock'; break (loop.py:127-129). All enforced and break the loop.
spec_features.notes: All three caps actually break the loop; per-turn cap actually passed to provider.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: max_tokens_per_turn: int = 2048    # completion cap per turn (cost control); wall_clock_s ... # hard time cap per run

spec_features.spec_quote: `give_up(reason)` — legitimate terminal action: "I cannot complete this; here's why."
spec_features.evidence: give_up schema requires 'reason' (tools.py:60-64). _t_give_up captures reason into meta; loop stores result.give_up_reason and stops (loop.py:158-160, 209-212).
spec_features.notes: Same mechanism as the report-blocked tool; reason is recorded.
